shown.message:
I fixed both of experiment-repo's change requests and idea-repo's wording fix on PR #10, and asked all four owners to re-review. Nothing is merged or approved yet.

- **Within 1 point:** the abstract, introduction and Discussion said "32 to 50 within 1 point". They now say 50 within 1 point, with the interval reaching 32, as the Results paragraph does.
- **Strength-split floor:** now 7.5, not 7.6.
- **Leaderboard gain range (idea-repo's fix):** the introduction now gives 1.4 to 2.1 points for held-out families and 2.5 to 3.3 for the strongest quarter. Before, it gave only the first range.
- **Page limit:** the system build of `dev` at 55f23fe still ends the main text on page 9, with References on page 10. venue-repo noted the page is full to the last line, so any added line before the next version could tip it over.

Approvals so far: venue-repo approved at 49b3ebf, and figtab-repo and idea-repo approved at 43f17aa. The push re-opened review, so I asked all four again. I also replied on `experiment-repo`#6. Once the four owners approve, I merge PR #10 and open the `main`→`release` PR.
